name: SmartTags AI for WooCommerce
author: Webdirection

sections.description:
SmartTags AI for WooCommerce helps store owners generate relevant product tags automatically using Google search suggestions and optional AI services.

The plugin is designed to reduce manual tagging effort by using real search queries and configurable rules, while giving you full control over when and how tags are applied.

The free version works out of the box using Google Search Suggestions (no API key required) and supports optional AI-based tag generation with your own API keys.

Key Features

  • Automatic Tag Generation – Generate product tags using Google Search Suggestions (free, no API key required)
  • Optional AI Tag Generation – Generate tags using external AI providers (Google Gemini, Groq, OpenAI) with your own API keys
  • Two Automation Modes
    • Semi-automatic mode – Generate tags and review them before applying
    • Fully automatic mode – Apply generated tags automatically using WordPress cron
  • Category Filtering – Select which product categories should be processed
  • Tag Limits – Set a maximum number of tags per product (configurable between 3 and 30)
  • Tag Quality Management – Replace low-quality tags automatically when the tag limit is reached
  • Stopwords Filtering – Built-in filtering excludes unwanted or low-quality terms
  • Scheduling – Run automation on a weekly or monthly schedule
  • Testing Tools – Test tag generation on individual or sample products before running automation
  • Review Queue – Review and approve generated tags in semi-automatic mode

Pro Version

SmartTags Pro is an optional upgrade that adds cloud-based automation and monitoring.

The Pro version provides:
* Cloud-based fully automatic mode that runs independently of local WordPress cron
* Job execution logs and status monitoring
* Improved reliability for scheduled automation
* Priority support

The free version already includes local automation, Google Search Suggestions, and optional AI-powered tag generation using your own API keys.

How It Works

  1. Test tag generation on individual or sample products
  2. Configure tag limits, filters, and categories
  3. Choose semi-automatic or fully automatic mode
  4. Schedule automation
  5. Review results (if using semi-automatic mode)

Use Cases

  • Generate product tags based on real Google search suggestions
  • Maintain consistent tagging across large product catalogs
  • Reduce manual tagging work for WooCommerce stores
  • Replace outdated or low-quality tags automatically

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Telemetry & Privacy

  • Telemetry is disabled by default.
  • When disabled, the plugin operates locally and does not contact external services except Google Search Suggestions and selected AI providers.
  • When enabled, the plugin may contact webdirection.com.au to:
    • Fetch shared AI model lists and prompt templates
    • Sync license status for SmartTags Pro
  • Data sent (only when telemetry is enabled):
    • Site URL
    • Domain fingerprint
    • Plugin version and license status
    • Anonymous usage counters
  • No customer, order, or personal data is transmitted.
  • Telemetry can be disabled at any time in the plugin settings.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

webdirection.com.au
* Purpose: License validation for SmartTags Pro, cloud-based scheduling, shared AI model configuration, and prompt template updates
* Data sent (only when telemetry is enabled):
* Site URL and domain fingerprint
* Plugin version and license status
* Anonymous usage counters
* Terms of Service: https://webdirection.com.au/terms-of-service/
* Privacy Policy: https://webdirection.com.au/privacy-policy/
* Note: No customer, order, or product data is transmitted

Google Search Suggestions API (suggestqueries.google.com)
* Purpose: Fetch real-time search suggestions for tag generation
* Data sent: Product titles and keywords
* Authentication: None (public API)
* Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Optional AI Service Providers
These services are used only if AI features are enabled and the corresponding provider is selected.

  • Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com)

    • Data sent: Product titles and descriptions
    • Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms
    • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • Groq API (api.groq.com)

    • Data sent: Product titles and descriptions
    • Terms: https://groq.com/terms-of-service/
    • Privacy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/

  • OpenAI API (api.openai.com)

    • Data sent: Product titles and descriptions
    • Terms: https://openai.com/api/policies/terms/
    • Privacy: https://openai.com/api/policies/privacy-policy/

Support

Support and bug reports:
https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/smarttags-for-woocommerce/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smarttags-ai-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Go to Woo-SmartTags in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Test tag generation before enabling automation.
  6. Configure scheduling and automation settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an API key?

No API key is required for Google Search Suggestions.
AI-based tag generation requires API keys for the selected provider.

What data leaves my site?

By default, only product titles or keywords are sent to Google Search Suggestions or selected AI providers for tag generation.
No customer or order data is transmitted. Telemetry is disabled by default and optional.

Can I review tags before they are applied?

Yes. Semi-automatic mode allows you to review and approve tags before applying them.

How many tags can be generated per product?

You can configure a maximum tag limit between 3 and 30 tags per product.

  • Compatible with WordPress 5.8+ and WooCommerce 5.0+
